channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kenny Smith | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kenny Smith from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kenny Smith
item.description:
“Kenny Smith was my roommate. We stayed right on the ocean, nearby. Our pool play was here, and then we went through different cities.”

Steve Kerr on Kenny Smith, Aug 12, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Washington Generals on Kenny Smith
item.description:
“They had a lack of talent and poor coaching. Now we’re changing everything around. We have [TNT NBA studio analyst] Kenny Smith as the general manager and myself as coach. “We took three years off for planning and preparation for how to beat the Globetrotters. We did a lot of scouting, Kenny and I, watching all kinds of tapes, looking at the Globetrotters’ strengths and weaknesses. And we recruited a bunch of guys with special talents who believe they can win.”

Washington Generals on Kenny Smith, Mar 17, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jason Terry on Kenny Smith
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Jason Terry:

“My coaching philosophy and strategies will be way more in depth and better than @Kenny Smith”

Jason Terry on Kenny Smith, Jun 15, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Kenny Smith
item.description:
Shaq on Kenny Smith:

“Kenny's a nerd. He's one of those guys that tries to use big words and doesn't know what they mean.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Kenny Smith, Jan 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.
